settings.heading: Technical specifications
settings.rows:
Model: GhostTint™ Smart SPD Window Tint Film
Switching type: Smooth gradual dimming, 7-level adjustable transparency
Tint range (VLT): Clear ~65–70%, Dark ~5–10%
Film size: 100cm x 100cm, trim-to-fit
Control method: Wireless remote control
Power source: Vehicle ACC, ignition-linked power
Material: Automotive-grade SPD smart film
Installation type: Professional installation recommended, DIY possible for flat glass
Compatibility: Most sedans, SUVs and coupes; side and rear windows only
Operating voltage: 12V DC
Operating temperature: -30°C to +85°C
UV / heat rejection: Blocks over 99% UV rays
Power consumption: Low power, draws only when transitioning or holding clear state

settings.heading: Every window. One system.
settings.caption: The same tint, the same remote, on every window you fit it to.

settings.question: What VLT range can I select?
settings.answer: GhostTint™ adjusts across seven levels, spanning approximately 5% to 70% VLT. Tint laws vary by location, so always check the rules that apply to your vehicle and windows.

settings.question: How is GhostTint™ controlled?
settings.answer: With the included wireless remote. The control system is powered from the vehicle and lets you adjust the tint level on demand.

settings.question: What is included with the 2-window option?
settings.answer: The 2-window kit includes two trim-to-fit smart tint films plus the wireless remote and control system. Setup guidance, tinting tools, warranty cover and installation support are also included.

settings.question: What is included with the 4-window option?
settings.answer: The 4-window kit includes four trim-to-fit smart tint films plus the wireless remote and control system. It also includes the same setup guidance, tinting tools, warranty cover and installation support.

settings.question: Is installation support available?
settings.answer: Yes. Installation guidance and support are included. Professional installation is recommended for the cleanest result, while experienced DIY installers can follow the supplied guidance.

settings.question: Which window option should I choose?
settings.answer: Choose 1 Window for a single install, 2 Windows for a smaller multi-window installation, or 4 Windows for full side-window coverage.
